name: bash-lanes-and-frame-sends
brief: Fix three defects seen running Orcastrate, plus one backlog row. (1) The CLI now sends a system/task_started with task_type 'local_bash' for every Bash call, and LaneRouter registers a Calf lane for each, so one Pod holds 327 Bash lanes. Only a task_type of 'local_agent', or none, will open a lane; a Bash task's later task messages stay Matriarch system events. Stored lanes are left as they are. (2) A Bash call that exits non-zero comes back as an isError tool_result 'Exit code N', which the transcript renders red and expanded. When the matching tool_use is Bash, the row will render collapsed and labelled 'Tool result (exit N)'; every other error keeps its treatment. (3) sendToRenderers threw 'Render frame was disposed' up through event persistence. The broadcast moves to a tested module that skips crashed or unusable frames, catches and logs a failing send once per episode, and logs render-process-gone. (4) migration-frozen.test.ts gains migrations 5 and 6.
